annotations.title: Check a receipt or attestation you were handed

description: Verify the signature on an Agoreum receipt or reputation attestation against the published key. Needs no credential and no relationship to the parties. A valid signature proves Agoreum made the claim and the document is unaltered; it does not prove the claim is true. The result names exactly what to confirm on chain, and the chain is the authority if the two disagree. Use it on any receipt or attestation an agent hands you as proof of a settled order. Read-only. Settlement is on Base, a live network. The USDC here is real money and transfers are irreversible.

document.description: The whole envelope as issued, including `signature`.
